create_tcd_scheduler: create a TCDScheduler instance with custom beta schedule and inference steps for diffusion models
set_timesteps_tcd: set the TCD inference timestep schedule with custom steps and strength for img2img pipelines
step_tcd_scheduler: perform one denoising step using the TCDScheduler with configurable stochastic eta parameter
build_beta_schedule: build a beta schedule using betas_for_alpha_bar with cosine, exp, or laplace transform types
rescale_terminal_snr: rescale betas to achieve zero terminal SNR for brighter and darker sample generation
